! colspan="3" | Evolution I Challenge !! Kill '''100''' enemies with the Onos.

! EVO1
| style="white-space: nowrap; text-align:center;" | '''Incarnon Form''' [[File:EvolutionIncarnonFormGun.png|64px|center]]
| 
* Weakpoint Hits charge Incarnon Transmutation; Alt Fire transmutes. Switching back will expend any remaining charge. 
| 
* Incarnon Form changes the weapon from an automatic hand cannon to charging [[Arm-Cannon]]. Holding down the trigger releases a wide beam that inflicts {{D|Radiation}} damage. The beam narrows and increases in damage the longer the charge is held. Once fully charged, the Arm Cannon releases a powerful {{D|Heat}} shot with guaranteed status, '''5''' meter [[Punch Through]], and explodes in a 3 meter radius.
** Beam damage scales linearly up to '''2.5x''' damage. Resets after releasing the trigger or firing a charged shot.
** Onos consumes '''1''' round per tick of damage, then '''50''' rounds upon releasing the {{D|Heat}} beam. The charged beam will deal full damage even if there iss less than 50 charges remaining. 
*Incarnon Form uses Arm-Cannon animations. Contrary to its appearance, the Onos is still considered a Secondary weapon.
|-

|-
